title: fix(cli): report missing isolate/voice-change input as a CLI error
author: zilin6666-svg

gist.summary: The `polli gen isolate` and `polli gen voice-change` commands now check that an input file exists before reading it. A missing file produces the CLI’s standard `error: File not found: <file>` message and exit code 1 instead of a raw Node `ENOENT` message; neither command makes an API request.
